title: Citrix security advisory (AV26-1150)
description: As of November 12, 2026, Citrix is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
	Prior to 13.1-64.39
Prior to 14.1-73.57

NetScaler ADC FIPS
	Prior to 14.1-73.58 FIPS
Prior to 13.1-37.293 FIPS & NDcPP

Secure Access Client for Linux
	Prior to 26.10.4

Secure Access Client for Windows
	Prior to 26.11.16
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
